confirmed_blank.document: Banco Central de Nicaragua, Informe de Estados Financieros BCN 2024 (audited, final)
confirmed_blank.section: Notes 1-5 covering international reserves: Note 3 Billetes y monedas extranjeras, Note 4 Depósitos en el exterior, plus the accounting-policy section
confirmed_blank.finding: There is no monetary gold line in the balance sheet and no gold note. 'Oro' appears only in policy wording about obligations denominated in gold and in the valuation rule ('oro y plata, se utilizará el precio de referencia a nivel internacional'). The only vault figures ('Bóveda en movimiento' C$364,126,638 and 'Bóveda de reservas' C$18,736,917,057) are foreign banknotes and coin, not gold. The audit key-matter wording mentions 'confirmaciones externas de los custodios internacionales' without naming one.

confirmed_blank.document: Central Bank of Kenya, Annual Report & Financial Statements 2025/26 (year ended 30 June 2026)
confirmed_blank.section: Notes to the Financial Statements, Note 17(b) Gold Holdings
confirmed_blank.finding: The whole gold note is four sentences of accounting policy. It gives the carrying value (KShs 230 million in 2026, KShs 238 million in 2025) and says the holdings are non-monetary gold accounted for under IAS 2 using World Gold Council concepts. It names no custodian, no vault and no city, and the word 'custody' does not appear anywhere near gold in the document.

confirmed_blank.document: Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan, Annual Report 2025
confirmed_blank.section: Section 2.4, 'Storage and management of international gold and foreign exchange reserves held by the Central Bank'
confirmed_blank.finding: The section whose own title is about storage describes tranches, benchmarks, external managers and currency composition (93 per cent US dollars, 1 per cent renminbi and Qatari riyals, 6 per cent SDRs) and never breaks gold out or names a place. No custodian, vault or city appears; 'gold' occurs only in the compound phrase 'gold - foreign exchange reserves'.

confirmed_blank.section: Section 3.2.9 Commentaires sur les postes du bilan, Actif, Note 1 Avoirs et placements en or
confirmed_blank.finding: The gold note says the line covers gold held in Morocco and with foreign depositaries, plus gold placements with foreign counterparties. It names no depositary, no vault and no city, so only a country-level answer is on offer, which this row refuses.

confirmed_blank.document: Central Bank of Nigeria, 2022 Financial Statements
confirmed_blank.section: Note 16g Gold Bullion (and the monetary gold accounting policy note)
confirmed_blank.finding: The gold note gives the quantity and price only: 687,402 troy ounces at an indicative USD1,824.02 per ounce, carrying value N578,645 million. No custodian, vault or city is named. The Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan names in the same statements belong to a securities lending agreement over foreign securities, not to gold storage.

confirmed_blank.document: National Bank of Georgia, Annual Report 2024 (English)
confirmed_blank.section: The monetary gold passages in the macroeconomic review and international reserves discussion, and the cash and valuables management section
confirmed_blank.finding: Every gold passage is about buying, not holding. The report says the NBG bought USD 500 million of monetary gold in March 2024 and that 'the gradual purchase and receipt of standardized gold bars of the highest standard at various weights from LBMA-accredited companies were ensured'. Those are sellers, not custodians. Searching the document for custody, safekeeping, vault and allocated returns only securities-depository and pension-depository matter; no gold custodian, vault or city is named.

confirmed_blank.document: The Herald (Zimbabwe), "Auditors BDO confirm Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe's gold balance"
confirmed_blank.finding: The article reports 2.67 tonnes of gold at 31 December 2024 verified by BDO Zimbabwe, and says BDO's procedures included physical verification, but it names no vault, refinery, institution or city for where that gold sits. Not a close on the RBZ's own accounts, only on this route.

needs_a_hand_check.problem: The Banco Nacional de Angola site is a single-page app: https://www.bna.ao/#/pt/publicacoes-e-estatisticas/publicacoes/relatorio-e-contas reset the connection on first attempt and the homepage then served only a 7 KB shell with no document links, and every path (including /api/publicacoes) returns the same shell. Four searches for the Relatorio e Contas PDF returned only Angolan commercial banks (BFA, BIC, Atlantico, Banco Economico, BDA), never bna.ao. The PDF needs to be picked out of the site by hand, then grepped for 'ouro'.

Both Central Bank of Armenia document paths that the search returned (Annual_Report_2022.pdf and IFRS_FS_CBA_30.09.23_Eng.pdf) answer 404 with a 37 KB HTML error page, so the publication paths have moved. The IFRS financial statements need to be located from the bank's current publications index.

searched_no_result.note: The only Central Bank of Iraq documents the search surfaced on cbi.iq are monthly Statements of Financial Position. Two were downloaded (30 April 2026 and 31 May 2026): each is a one-page balance sheet whose first asset line is 'Gold reserve' (IQD 33,924,780 million and IQD 33,295,162 million respectively) with no notes and no custodian. An annual report with notes was not reachable from search.

The Bank of Jamaica 2025 annual report page (https://boj.org.jm/2025-boj-annual-report-final/) downloaded as a 33.6 MB HTML page that contains no PDF link and no occurrence of the word gold. No gold note was reachable.

Searching for the Bank of Tanzania's gold note returned only its monthly 'Statements of Financial Position as at' PDFs, around twenty of them, which carry no notes. No annual report with a gold note was surfaced.

A Spanish-language search for the Banco Central de la Republica Dominicana's audited statements returned only Banreservas (a state commercial bank) and Superintendencia de Bancos documents, never the central bank's own statements.

A Spanish-language search for Banco Central del Ecuador audited statements with a gold note returned only press coverage of reserve totals and a presentation hosted by a news site, no central bank financial statements.

Two searches for the Bank of Ghana 2024 annual report PDF returned only Ghanaian press coverage of the GH¢9.49 billion operating loss and the gold-for-oil programme. No bog.gov.gh document was surfaced.
A search for the Central Bank of Egypt's annual report gold note returned only commercial bank statements and press coverage of reserve totals; no CBE financial statements PDF appeared.

leads_not_opened.lead: The same Prothom Alo report says Standard Chartered Bank holds 92,739 troy ounces and HSBC 93,535 troy ounces of Bangladesh Bank's gold as of June, and that Bangladesh Bank's own vault holds 83,961 troy ounces. Neither the bank/branch city nor whether those two commercial holdings are storage or interest-bearing deposits is stated, so they were not filed. Bangladesh Bank's own Annual Report 2025-26 gold note would settle both, and would also name the city of its own vault.

Note 13 was read in the 2021 annual report because mongolbank.mn/documents/annualreport/2023e.pdf and 2024e.pdf both return 49 KB non-PDF pages. A newer Bank of Mongolia annual report would refresh the tonnage and confirm the Bank of England and JP Morgan Chase Bank placements still stand.

The 2023 Rapport Annuel was read from a third-party host (chaexpert.com). The Banque Centrale de Tunisie's own 2024 or 2025 report would give a current split between 'les caisses de la Banque' and 'Placés à terme', and may name the counterparty for the 1,406,032 grams placed on term.

Line 1663 of the same report mentions gold handed to the BCT by the customs service for safekeeping ('les services de la Douane et confiés à la BCT pour conservation') at end-December 2023. That is the BCT holding someone else's gold, which is a different relation from this row, but it may matter to a bailee row.

BDO Zimbabwe physically verified 2.67 tonnes of RBZ gold at 31 December 2024. The BDO assurance report or the RBZ's own audited accounts would say where that verification happened; the Fidelity Gold Refinery in Harare is the obvious candidate but was not confirmed in any document read.
Banco de Guatemala's statements also show 'Oro No Monetario' of Q503,584.56, unchanged year on year, with no location given. Minor, but a complete gold picture for Guatemala would need it.
